sourceTitle: Petty Troubles of Married Life, First Part
description: "Petty Troubles of Married Life, First Part" by Honoré de Balzac is a novel written during the early 19th century. The book offers a humorous yet insightful exploration of the myriad small challenges and complexities that arise in the realm of marriage, portraying characters like the somewhat hapless husband Adolphe and his charming but demanding wife Caroline.
